heroHeadline: Norway Freezes UNEP Funding as Legal Battle Erupts Over Right Whale Speed Rules
heroSubtitle: Norway — UNEP's largest financial contributor — suspended funding to the UN environment body in May 2026, threatening secretariat support for the stalled global plastics treaty negotiations ahead of INC-5.4. Simultaneously, conservation groups filed a legal motion to defend NOAA's vessel speed restrictions for North Atlantic Right Whales after the Trump administration backed legislation delaying new fishing rope rules until 2035. Heat-resistant 'super corals' surviving 36°C continue to offer reef restoration hope, while the 2025–26 right whale calving season concluded with 23 calves — the highest count since 2009.
footerNote: Data sourced from NOAA, UNEP, The Ocean Cleanup, IUCN, Australian Institute of Marine Science, High Seas Alliance, UN BBNJ Agreement, Center for Biological Diversity, ICRI, and major scientific institutions. Coordinates verified against NOAA and OpenStreetMap references.
